binary_imbalance_definition: number of 1 symbols minus number of 0 symbols
block_length_lower_bound: min_a |f(h^n(a))| >= 2^n; the g-branch is at least as large up to a constant factor
consequence: The supremum over length-L factors u of ||u|_1/L-1/2| tends to 0 as L tends to infinity.
derived_factor_bound: For every n>=1 there is a finite C_n such that every finite factor u of w satisfies |Delta(u)| <= 2^{-n}|u|+C_n.
identities: therefore Delta(f(h^n(a)))=d(a) and Delta(f(g(h^n(a))))=d(a) for all n>=0

source_theorem.statement_used: For every infinite binary rich 14/5-free word w and every integer n>=1, a suffix of w has the form f(h^n(v)) or f(g(h^n(v))) for some infinite ternary word v.
